bullets.text: Built a Python LLM service that drafts three reply options for every customer review (detailed, professional, short), with sentiment-conditioned prompts and per-dealership rules baked in; the dealer picks one and publishes. Roughly 93% of drafts go out without an edit, across over 100k reviews a month.

Fine-tuned Llama 3 8B using Python and LoRA/QLoRA (Unsloth) on examples generated by a 70B model, distilling its ability to follow strict client wording rules that the base model couldn't manage, while keeping small-model speed and cost.

Deployed with Docker on AWS EC2, configuring NVIDIA drivers and the Linux environment from scratch, then led the migration to an on-prem GPU server and added database-level caching of repeat requests to cut costs and response times.
